description: Deterministic Lead Scoring Configuration Rules and Weighting System

rules.reason: Direct match for core automation offerings.
Adjacent service supported with custom scoping.
Out of scope or unsupported domain.
Stated budget meets or exceeds enterprise/mid-market tier (>= 100k THB).
Stated budget fits starter/SMB automation package (40k - 99k THB).
Stated budget is below standard minimum engagement threshold.
Budget not explicitly stated; awarded neutral baseline points.
High urgency: prospect requires deployment within 30 days.
Medium urgency: prospect has a quarterly horizon (30-90 days).
Low urgency: exploratory or timeline unspecified.
Strong buying signals: clear pain points, concrete use case, ready to discuss.
Moderate interest: general inquiry seeking options and pricing.
Low purchase intent: student research or casual question.
Commercial spam or promotional solicitation.
Contact indicated founder, director, or executive authority.
Authority level not stated in initial contact form.
Operates in prime target vertical (healthcare, restaurant chains, ecommerce).
No company information provided.
Both email, phone, and company name provided.
Only email or phone provided without company details.

low_ai_confidence.description: Trigger review if AI extraction confidence is below 0.65.

large_opportunity_budget_thb.description: Flag for senior account executive review if budget >= 300k THB.

unsupported_service_with_high_intent.description: Flag for review if client has high intent but requested service is outside standard catalog.

spam_or_inappropriate.description: Flag to prevent automated outbound messaging to suspected spam leads.
